stories.text: Stanley Zabar, longtime co-owner of Zabar's, died Nov. 9 at 94.
stories.src: I Love the Upper West Side

stories.text: Consuelo (224 W. 104th) is No. 8 on The Infatuation's best new NYC restaurants of 2026. It's the only UWS pick.
stories.src: I Love the Upper West Side

stories.text: First look at Extell's 77–80 W. 66th St: 86 stories, 1,182 feet, and 500+ feet taller than anything else on the UWS.
Joe Kidd Cantina, a Western-themed Mexican bar, opened at 250 W. 72nd in the old Emerald Inn space.
stories.src: West Side Rag · I Love the UWS

stories.text: The “You've Got Mail” townhouse at 328 W. 89th is for sale: $3.95 million.
stories.src: I Love the Upper West Side

stories.text: The empty Verdi Square kiosk at 72nd & Broadway will become a flower shop, Verdi Blooms, in early 2027.
Zoe Saldaña is filming “Still Life” around W. 60th & Columbus, Nov. 11–13.
stories.src: I Love the Upper West Side

stories.text: The AMNH origami holiday tree returns Nov. 23, with an “animal athletes” theme.
stories.src: I Love the Upper West Side

caption:
UWS Briefly · Nov 5–11

• Stanley Zabar, co-owner of Zabar's, died at 94
• Consuelo (W. 104th) made The Infatuation's best new NYC restaurants of 2026
• First rendering of the UWS's future tallest tower, 1,182 ft at W. 66th
• Joe Kidd Cantina opened in the old Emerald Inn space on W. 72nd
• The “You've Got Mail” townhouse is listed at $3.95M
• A flower shop is coming to the Verdi Square kiosk
• Zoe Saldaña filming near W. 60th & Columbus through Nov. 13
• AMNH origami tree returns Nov. 23

Also this week: a suspect in an Oct. 24 Central Park rape was arrested in Miami; the Modest Needs charity founder got 8 years for spending donations on his Columbus Circle rent; a brush fire burned above the Morningside Park waterfall (no injuries); free special-ed resource fair at the JCC, Nov. 18.

Read the full stories at West Side Rag (westsiderag.com) and I Love the Upper West Side (ilovetheupperwestside.com).
